name: M3_PPS200MI_GetHead
description: Retrieve header information for a purchase order, including general order data, supplier and buyer references, dates, values, terms, and user‑defined attributes. The call returns one header record per purchase order and does not include any line‑level details. Use it to read current header status and control data without changing the order in M3.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number whose header information is retrieved.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number to use when searching for the purchase order; defaults to the logged-in company if omitted.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number that owns the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PUNO
outputParameters.description: Purchase order number.

outputParameters.name: DONR
outputParameters.description: Document number associated with the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: DOVA
outputParameters.description: Variant of the purchase order document layout or content.

outputParameters.name: DATE
outputParameters.description: Date when the purchase order record was created.

outputParameters.name: PUDT
outputParameters.description: Order date of the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: DWDT
outputParameters.description: Requested delivery date for the goods on this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: LEDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the purchase order document was first printed.

outputParameters.name: CONM
outputParameters.description: Name of the company that owns the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: REVN
outputParameters.description: Revision number of the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RENM
outputParameters.description: Name of the user responsible for the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number for the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: CSCD
outputParameters.description: Country code related to this purchase transaction, typically the supplier’s country.

outputParameters.name: BUYE
outputParameters.description: Buyer responsible for the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: CUCD
outputParameters.description: Currency code used on the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TXCU
outputParameters.description: Name of the currency used on the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TXPY
outputParameters.description: Description of the payment terms used for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TXMO
outputParameters.description: Description of the delivery method used for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TXDL
outputParameters.description: Description of the delivery terms for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TXAF
outputParameters.description: Description of the freight terms for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TXPA
outputParameters.description: Description of the packaging terms for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TXHA
outputParameters.description: Name of the harbor or airport used for shipping on this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: YRE1
outputParameters.description: Name of the contact person at the supplier for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PHNO
outputParameters.description: Telephone number for the supplier or contact person on the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TFNO
outputParameters.description: Fax number used for sending purchase order documents.

outputParameters.name: REVV
outputParameters.description: Net order amount before the latest revision.

outputParameters.name: REMK
outputParameters.description: Free-text remark or comment on the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: REV1
outputParameters.description: Order amount used as the base when calculating the revision difference.

outputParameters.name: COAM
outputParameters.description: Total order cost expressed in the order currency.

outputParameters.name: DIVI
outputParameters.description: Division responsible for the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse that will receive the goods on the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: ORTY
outputParameters.description: Order type that controls how the purchase order is processed.

outputParameters.name: LNCD
outputParameters.description: Language code used for printing external documents for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TEPY
outputParameters.description: Payment terms that control how the supplier invoice due date is calculated.

outputParameters.name: MODL

outputParameters.name: TEDL
outputParameters.description: Delivery terms defining when responsibility for the goods passes from supplier to buyer.

outputParameters.name: TEAF
outputParameters.description: Freight terms agreed for the goods on this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TEPA
outputParameters.description: Packaging terms describing how the goods on this purchase order are to be packed.

outputParameters.name: RFID
outputParameters.description: Reference ID linking the purchase order to a record in the reference file.

outputParameters.name: TEL1
outputParameters.description: Free-text terms printed on external documents for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: HAFE
outputParameters.description: Harbor or airport code used for trade statistics or transport reporting on this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: POTC
outputParameters.description: Category assigned to the purchase order, such as normal, consignment, or subcontract.

outputParameters.name: PYAD
outputParameters.description: Code identifying your company’s invoicing address printed on the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: MTDP
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether the purchase order uses multiple delivery addresses.

outputParameters.name: MTWP

outputParameters.name: OURR

outputParameters.name: OURT

outputParameters.name: PRSU

outputParameters.name: AGNT

outputParameters.name: NTAM

outputParameters.name: BRAM

outputParameters.name: CMCO
